title: The Color of Hedge Fund Activism
eligible_reason: Matched-control, event-window (stacked) design, excluded by PROTOCOL Section 2. Each hedge-fund activism event (caseid) consists of the target bank (activ=1) and matched non-target banks (activ=0) that are assigned the target's 13D filing date as their pseudo-event date (date_filed is populated for controls; in every data file each caseid has a single year_filed shared by target and controls; 27 of 134 banks in filing_activism.dta appear in more than one caseid). Every regression sample is restricted to event_year in [-3, 3] (e.g., baseline_code.do lines 246, 446, 873, 931, 1232, 1318). The headline specifications are triple differences (post x treat x minority) with bank-by-year (bhc_year) and MSA-by-year FE that absorb the DiD term, loan-level data, and time-varying controls (lines 272-280, Table 7). The few two-way DiD specifications (Table 8: total_discrimination_counts on post_treat with entity + filing_year FE, lines 878-881; Table 12 Panel A: max_acquisition on post_treat with entity + bank_year + caseid FE, lines 1114-1117) still use pseudo-dated matched controls within a +/-3 event window, so they are matching-based/stacked rather than a staggered TWFE on a calendar panel with never- or not-yet-treated controls. Branch-count outcomes (Tables 10, 14) use ppmlhdfe (Poisson).
design_notes: Single do-file (baseline_code.do, 1,544 lines; duplicate copy in data/ with Windows paths). Datasets: mortgage_activism_origination.dta (HMDA loan applications to target and matched banks; 1.66 GB), mcdash_activism.dta (HMDA-GSE-McDash matched loans, interest rates and performance), mortgage_activism_all_action.dta (withdrawn/incomplete applications), filing_activism.dta (bank-year counts of lending-discrimination keywords in filings), activism_mortgage_officer.dta (bank-county-year loan-officer turnover), activism_sod.dta (bank-county-year branch counts), activism_nmls_county.dta (bank-county-year loan officers), activism_acquiror.dta / activism_target.dta (bank-year acquisitions), activism_tract_cra_branch.dta (bank-tract-year branches), mortgage_census.dta (CRA vs non-CRA tracts), mortgage_activism_2018_2021.dta (newer HMDA), roa_capital/capital/small.dta (event-level splits). Treatment construction: treat = activ; post = year > year(date_filed); post_treat = post*treat; black = minority applicant; event_year = year - year_filed; events filed 2007-2009 dropped (keep if year_filed<2007 | year_filed>2009). Filing years span 2000-2014 (12 cohorts after exclusion). Figure 2 (line 241): dynamic DDD, black x treat x event-year dummies (-5..+5) with bhc_year, msa_year, race, sex FE and event-year x treat, event-year x black FE, clustered by entity_rssd. Clustering throughout by bank (entity).
estimators_reported: TWFE triple-difference (reghdfe; BHC-year + MSA-year FE; loan-level controls)
TWFE DiD on matched bank-year / bank-county-year panels (entity + year FE, +/-3 year event window)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: filing years 2000-2006 and 2010-2014 (2007-2009 excluded); but controls carry matched pseudo-event dates, so this is not a staggered calendar-panel design
modern_estimator_note: Full text cites Goodman-Bacon (2021), Callaway-Sant'Anna (2021), de Chaisemartin-D'Haultfoeuille (2020) but no modern estimator appears in the code.
